sources.snippet: MONAI/PyTorch implementation of a 2D U-Net for binary semantic segmentation of fluorescent cochlear inner hair cells in single-channel two-photon microscopy TIFF images. This model segments inner hair cells (IHCs) from in vivo (Paper) two-photon fluorescence images in which the fluorescent signal primarily labels afferent neurons and their synaptic terminals, rather than the hair cells ...
